cards.public_summary: Omar Cooper Jr. moved from the second-team offense to the starting slot role with the first team during the preseason.
cards.evidence: First-round rookie Omar Cooper Jr. trended up as camp and the preseason progressed. After playing with the second-team offense to open the preseason, Cooper was promoted to the starting slot receiver position with the first-team offense in Week 2, and he sat out the final preseason game.
cards.commentary: Cooper’s reported first-team slot promotion is a meaningful role signal for fantasy managers. Monitor whether he keeps that job into the regular season and how many routes it produces.
cards.author: Michael Nania
cards.model_original_commentary: Cooper’s reported first-team slot promotion is a meaningful role signal for fantasy managers. Monitor whether he keeps that job into the regular season and how many routes it produces.
draft_limitations: The evidence does not provide regular-season snap share, route volume or target expectations.
The report describes a preseason role change and does not confirm the role will continue in the regular season.
